name: n4_event_report
description: Report what happened during each alarm event of one source, in one call: per event (newest first) the alarm database times and the source's history over the event window, so 'how high did it get' needs no date arithmetic and no second tool. Name the alarms by source (a component ORD such as station:|slot:/Folder/Point/AmpsAlarm; matches it and everything below it) or source_glob (a BQL like pattern over the stored source such as *slot:/Folder/*; no quote, space, '$' or '|'); give exactly one; optional since and until (BAbsTime, e.g. 2026-11-15T00:00:00.000-06:00, or a span back from now such as 30m, 24h or 7d) narrow the alarm time; max_events (default 10, 1 to 100) caps the events read. Every record is read, open or not: the alarm database keeps one record per event (one uuid), updated in place when the source returns to normal and when it is acknowledged. Each event is {uuid, source, alarm_class, transition, source_state, ack_state, alarm_time, normal_time, ack_time, acked_by, records, window, history, summary}: times are ISO-8601 with the station's offset (null when not set; acked_by is the record's user, null until acknowledged); window {start, end, end_is_now} is [alarm_time - margin_minutes, normal_time + margin_minutes] (default 15, 0 to 1440), up to now while the source has not returned to normal. history is the history read: history_id when given (a bare name is a history of the connected station) for every event, else the history extension on the alarm source's component (the alarm extension's parent) or on the source itself, found once per source with select slotPath, historyConfig.id from history:HistoryExt (history {id, found_by: history_id or history_ext, ext_slot, other_exts when several match: the first is read}). summary is n4_read_history's summary over the window: {count, complete, records_scanned, numeric, min {value, timestamp}, max {value, timestamp} (the peak and when; a tie keeps the earliest), first, last, status_counts}. No history found, a source that is not a slot path, or a failed read is history and/or summary null with summary_note on that event, never a failed report. truncated is true when more events match than max_events; total_events is their count (select count(*)), null with total_events_note when that count failed. Every filter value is checked before any request, as n4_read_alarms and n4_read_history check them. Read-only: fixed queries over the alarm: and history: ORDs.

source.description: Component ORD whose alarm events to report, itself and below, e.g. station:|slot:/Folder/Point/AmpsAlarm

source_glob.description: BQL like pattern over the record source, '*' any run of characters, e.g. *slot:/Folder/*

history_id.description: History to read for every event, /<station>/<history name> or a bare name of the connected station; default: the history extension beside the alarm source

since.description: Oldest alarm time as a BAbsTime, e.g. 2026-11-15T00:00:00.000-06:00, or a span back from now: 30m, 24h, 7d

until.description: Newest alarm time as a BAbsTime, e.g. 2026-11-15T23:59:59.999-06:00, or a span back from now: 30m, 24h, 7d

margin_minutes.description: Minutes of history read before the alarm time and after the normal time

timeout_s.description: HTTP timeout per request in seconds
